q: MAC address kitne bits ka hota hai?
explain: MAC address 48 bits = 6 bytes ka hota hai; pehle 24 bits OUI (manufacturer) hote hain.

q: ARP request aur reply kaise bheje jaate hain?
explain: ARP request broadcast hota hai (sab ko), par sirf sahi host unicast reply bhejta hai.

q: Data 100100, generator 1101. Transmitted CRC (remainder) kya hoga?
explain: 3 zeros jod ke mod-2 division karne par remainder 001 aata hai; codeword 100100001 banta hai.

q: m = 3 sequence bits par Go-Back-N ka maximum sender window kya hai?
explain: Go-Back-N window = 2^m - 1 = 2^3 - 1 = 7. (Selective Repeat window 2^(m-1) = 4 hota hai.)

q: Collision domains ko kaun sa device todta hai (har port alag banata hai)?
explain: Switch har port ko alag collision domain banata hai. Router broadcast domains todta hai.
